baselineImpact: The first harness run had 242 simulator-only inventory dead ends; DraftForge recorded no illegal decision in completed trials.
expectedImprovement: Enough undrafted depth for noisy 14-team roster distributions without relaxing any roster rule.
observedEvidence: All 242 original failure seeds replayed successfully; the corrected 20,000-draft baseline completed 20,000/20,000 with zero violations.
safetyRisks: A larger synthetic board increases runtime.
This fixes simulation inventory only and is not evidence of a production draft-engine defect.

affectedDecisionClass: ZERO_RB recommendation ordering for an unfilled mandatory RB starter after 55% roster completion
baselineImpact: ZERO_RB was the weakest preset in both formats and repeatedly delayed required RB value; the affected paired seeds included high regret and materially weaker starting lineups.
expectedImprovement: Improve late mandatory-starter ordering while preserving the first 55% of Zero-RB behavior.

observedEvidence.sleeperProtection: No material change in acquisition or timing; validation sleeper metrics were identical in salary-cap.

safetyRisks: The Zero-RB preset becomes less aggressive late, while its early identity is unchanged.
Mean roster-fragility score increased by about 0.03 in snake trials as mandatory starter strength displaced occasional backup depth.
Auction max-bid calculations deliberately retain the configured preset multiplier, so the change cannot raise a walk-away ceiling.

affectedDecisionClass: Salary-cap regret accounting for nominations DraftForge did not acquire
baselineImpact: The auction evaluator charged immediate player-choice regret for a nomination even when an opponent won that player. The nomination was not a DraftForge roster acquisition and therefore should not affect acquisition regret or the composite objective.
expectedImprovement: Keep target-versus-drain nomination probes available for counterfactual analysis while excluding non-acquisitions from aggregate decision regret.
observedEvidence: Across a paired 1,000-snake plus 1,000-salary-cap check, all 2,000 draft digests and roster metrics were identical. Snake regret was unchanged; salary-cap false regret fell in every trial, reducing the all-format mean by 109.6451 points. The corrected 20,000-draft baseline and final candidate both completed with zero failures and zero hard violations.
safetyRisks: Historical regret and composite-objective reports must be regenerated before comparison.
Nomination proxy scores remain useful only for selecting bounded counterfactual cases and are labeled separately from acquisition regret.
